modifications: Adapted the original local audio-x-ortb30-placement-audio media/asset fixture into a ortb-3.0 unspecified auction.
Changed actual distribution-channel/device objects, matched request/response IDs and creative marker; assertions require the corresponding detected runtime contexts.
Use AdCOM device.type and lang; omit optional OS rather than copying the incompatible OpenRTB 2.x string os. Inline audio/video/display markup is admitted via placement.admx=1.
All prices/floors/currencies, impression/item references, media constraints and required Native assets remain explicitly matched.
Add original AdServingId after Impression: VAST4.1 Inline_type requires it (IAB VAST XSD revision e0858cd714474bf17ef61065097456d7643ff838).
provenance.sanitized: Original synthetic creatives and reserved .test resource hosts; TEST-NET device address where supplied. No customer payloads, personal identifiers or live advertising/tracking calls.

pairApplicability.note: Matched auction and impression/item references; source archive identifies the reusable seed corpus, not this newly authored context variant.

specNotes: Primary context definitions: https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/AdCOM/blob/df8ba06de0ba77c82efee7a2dc832bd4968474d6/AdCOM%20v1.0%20FINAL.md#requestcontext; device.type=3 is Connected TV (https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/AdCOM/blob/df8ba06de0ba77c82efee7a2dc832bd4968474d6/AdCOM%20v1.0%20FINAL.md#list_devicetypes), whereas site/app/dooh identify the distribution channel.
The request deliberately omits the distribution channel and device. Detector contexts must be empty; optional-context guidance must not become a validation error.

The oracle asserts auction identity, offered impression/item resolution, matching currency and above-floor price, media/native/size semantics where applicable, and exact creative identity; these are not metadata-only copies.
IAB dialect is used without disabled rules.

The marker is newly authored and must be visible in the selected original bid. Existing reserved media URLs/controlled assets are retained; no media delivery or playback success is inferred from inert VAST text.
notes: New coverage-closure case; normative expectations precede execution. Exact deviations are tracked separately after measured Core/HTTP/browser execution.
